text:
sam: Customer (acct: acme-corp) getting 429s intermittently 15:02-15:10 UTC, but RatePanel shows ~90% available. Can @kai or @anna help correlate enforcement logs vs dashboard? link: https://redwood.app/s/issue/ACME-129

kai: Which tenant id + a sample request_id? Do we have enforcer logs for those timestamps?

sam: tenant=acme-corp, request_id=rid_987654321, attaching snippet from gateway logs:
```json
{"ts":"2026-03-16T15:05:12Z","tenant":"acme-corp","req_id":"rid_987654321","status":429,"reason":"rate_limit","backend_decision":"throttle","bucket_key":"owner:12345"}
```

metrics-bot: Metrics ingest lag detected: metrics-ingest (pipeline: aggregator-to-timeseries) is 22m behind (latest processed offset: 542122, head offset: 542998). See https://metrics.redwood/ingest/alerts/167

anna: I see the aggregator had a Kafka consumer stall around 14:50 due to a GC spike on aggregator-3. It recovered but there was ~20m backlog. That could explain dashboard staleness.

kai: Adding to that — enforcement uses the token key namespace "owner:<owner_id>" while the metrics pipeline emits counters keyed by "tenant:<tenant_name>" (acme-corp). There's a join mismatch in the counters/lookup layer. Enforcement consulted owner:12345 (showing zero usage) while dashboard queried tenant:acme-corp (showing low usage). So enforcement correctly throttled based on owner-level real-time counters, dashboard later reflected tenant-level aggregate.

sam: Oof. So customer sees dashboard that says capacity but got throttled. What's the quick mitigation?

kai: Short-term: enable enforcement fallback to tenant namespace for 1 hour for affected tenants (will reduce strictness but unblock). I'll prepare a canary flag: `feature.enf.fallback_to_tenant=true` for region-us-east-1. Steps:
1) create canary flag in config service
2) push small rollout to 3 enforcement instances
3) watch `throttle.rate` and `throttle.false_positive` metrics

anna: Long-term fix: update aggregator connector to emit both keys (owner:<id> and tenant:<name>) and add a migration job to backfill missing owner->tenant mapping for the last 48h. Also add schema validation in the pipeline to catch key namespace drift.

ella: Filed INC-4321 to update dashboard UI to show "data freshness" and a tooltip explaining enforcement vs panel namespaces. Also created ENG-7192 to add a unit test ensuring namespace parity.

sam: Can we timeline the canary? Customer waiting for update.

kai: Pushing canary now. Expecting rollout finish in ~8m. I'll post results. :thumbsup:

metrics-bot: Canary flag created: feature.enf.fallback_to_tenant=true (canary=3/3). Monitor: https://metrics.redwood/alerts/ENF-CANARY-98

sam: Thanks — I'll ping customer with workaround and ETA.

kai: Post-rollout check: throttle.rate decreased from 18/min -> 2/min for acme-corp. Dashboard will take ~20m to catch up after backfill.

ella: Noted for postmortem. I'll add remediation tasks and owner.

sam: closing loop with customer. Good job team. :tada:
